head: sb
title: TinyOrHuge_storybook
transcript: Is this jar tiny or huge? Your shopper can't tell either. Forty-two percent of shoppers try to judge size from the photos. No hand, no scale, no clue. So put it in a hand. Then add three more: a texture close-up, one in use, and the back label. Every photo should answer a question. Comment STORE, and we'll check yours.
